versos.grego: Ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος· καὶ καθίσαντος αὐτοῦ προσῆλθαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
controles.kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
controles.livre: E quando Jesus viu as multidões, subiu a um monte; e sentando-se, achegaram-se a ele os seus discípulos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς λέγων

controles.web: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
controles.kjv: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
controles.livre: Então ele abriu sua boca e lhes ensinou, dizendo:

versos.grego: Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
controles.kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Benditos  são os humildes de espírito,  porque deles é o Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται.

controles.web: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
controles.kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
controles.livre: Benditos são os que choram, porque eles serão consolados.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ πραεῖς, ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν.

controles.web: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
controles.kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
controles.livre: Benditos são os mansos, porque eles herdarão a terra.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην, ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται.

controles.web: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness,  for they shall be filled.
controles.kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
controles.livre: Benditos são os que têm fome e sede de justiça, porque eles serão saciados.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ ἐλεήμονες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐλεηθήσονται.

controles.web: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
controles.kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
controles.livre: Benditos são os misericordiosos, porque eles alcançarão misericórdia.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ καθαροὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ, ὅτι αὐτοὶ τὸν Θεὸν ὄψονται.

controles.web: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
controles.kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
controles.livre: Benditos são os limpos de coração, porque eles verão a Deus.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ εἰρηνοποιοί, ὅτι αὐτοὶ υἱοὶ Θεοῦ κληθήσονται.

controles.web: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
controles.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
controles.livre: Benditos são os pacíficos, porque eles serão chamados filhos de Deus.

versos.grego: μακάριοι οἱ δεδιωγμένοι ἕνεκεν δικαιοσύνης, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake,  for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
controles.kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Benditos são os que sofrem perseguição por causa da justiça, porque deles é o Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν ὀνειδίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξωσιν καὶ εἴπωσιν πᾶν πονηρὸν καθ’ ὑμῶν ψευδόμενοι ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
controles.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
controles.livre: Benditos sois vós, quando vos insultarem, perseguirem, e mentirem, falando contra vós todo mal por minha causa.

versos.grego: χαίρετε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὅτι ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς· οὕτως γὰρ ἐδίωξαν τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πρὸ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
controles.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
controles.livre: Jubilai e alegrai-vos, porque grande é vossa recompensa nos céus; pois assim perseguiram aos profetas que foram antes de vós.

versos.grego: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ ἅλας τῆς γῆς· ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ, ἐν τίνι ἁλισθήσεται; εἰς οὐδὲν ἰσχύει ἔτι εἰ μὴ βληθὲν ἔξω καταπατεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
controles.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
controles.livre: Vós sois o sal da terra; mas se o sal perder seu sabor, com que se salgará? Para nada mais presta, a não ser para se lançar fora, e ser pisado pelas pessoas.

versos.grego: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου. οὐ δύναται πόλις κρυβῆναι ἐπάνω ὄρους κειμένη·

controles.web: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
controles.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
controles.livre: Vós sois a luz do mundo; não se pode esconder uma cidade fundada sobre o monte;

versos.grego: οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον, ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.

controles.web: Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
controles.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
controles.livre: Nem se acende a lâmpada para se pôr debaixo de um cesto, mas sim na luminária, e ilumina a todos quantos estão na casa.

versos.grego: οὕτως λαμψάτω τὸ φῶς ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
controles.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
controles.livre: Assim brilhe vossa luz diante das pessoas, para que vejam vossas boas obras, e glorifiquem ao vosso Pai, que está nos céus.

versos.grego: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον ἢ τοὺς προφήτας· οὐκ ἦλθον καταλῦσαι ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι·

controles.web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
controles.kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
controles.livre: Não penseis que vim para revogar a Lei ou os Profetas; não vim para revogar, mas sim para cumprir.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἕως ἂν παρέλθῃ ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ, ἰῶτα ἓν ἢ μία κεραία οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου, ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται.

controles.web: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letteror one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
controles.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
controles.livre: Porque em verdade vos digo que, até que o céu e a terra passem, nem um jota nem um til passará da Lei até que tudo aconteça.

versos.grego: ὃς ἐὰν οὖν λύσῃ μίαν τῶν ἐντολῶν τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων καὶ διδάξῃ οὕτως τοὺς ἀνθρώπους, ἐλάχιστος κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν· ὃς δ’ ἂν ποιήσῃ καὶ διδάξῃ, οὗτος μέγας κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
controles.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Portanto qualquer um que desobedecer a um destes menores mandamentos, e assim ensinar às pessoas, será chamado o menor no Reino dos céus; porém qualquer que os cumprir e ensinar, esse será chamado grande no Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ περισσεύσῃ ὑμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη πλεῖον τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
controles.kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
controles.livre: Porque eu vos digo que se a vossa justiça não for maior que a dos escribas e dos fariseus, de maneira nenhuma entrareis no Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις Οὐ φονεύσεις· ὃς δ’ ἂν φονεύσῃ, ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει.

controles.web: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever shall murder shall be in danger of the judgment.’
controles.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
controles.livre: Ouvistes o que foi dito aos antigos: “Não cometerás homicídio”;  “mas qualquer um que cometer homicídio será réu do julgamento”.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὀργιζόμενος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει· ὃς δ’ ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ Ῥακά, ἔνοχος ἔσται τῷ συνεδρίῳ· ὃς δ’ ἂν εἴπῃ Μωρέ, ἔνοχος ἔσται εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός.

controles.web: But I tell you, that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause   shall be in danger of the judgment; and whoever shall say to his brother, ‘Raca!’ shall be in danger of the council; and whoever shall say, ‘You fool!’ shall be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se irar contra seu irmão  será réu do julgamento. E qualquer um que disser a seu irmão: “Idiota!” será réu do tribunal.  E qualquer que lhe disser: “Louco!” será réu do fogo do inferno.

versos.grego: ἐὰν οὖν προσφέρῃς τὸ δῶρόν σου ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κἀκεῖ μνησθῇς ὅτι ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἔχει τι κατὰ σοῦ,

controles.web: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
controles.kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
controles.livre: Portanto, se trouxeres tua oferta ao altar, e ali te lembrares que teu irmão tem algo contra ti,

versos.grego: ἄφες ἐκεῖ τὸ δῶρόν σου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ὕπαγε πρῶτον διαλλάγηθι τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου, καὶ τότε ἐλθὼν πρόσφερε τὸ δῶρόν σου.

controles.web: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
controles.kjv: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
controles.livre: Deixa ali tua oferta diante do altar e vai primeiro reconciliar-te com teu irmão, e então vem oferecer a tua oferta.

versos.grego: ἴσθι εὐνοῶν τῷ ἀντιδίκῳ σου ταχὺ ἕως ὅτου εἶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ· μή ποτέ σε παραδῷ ὁ ἀντίδικος τῷ κριτῇ, καὶ ὁ κριτὴς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ, καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν βληθήσῃ·

controles.web: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
controles.kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
controles.livre: Faze acordo depressa com teu adversário, enquanto estás com ele no caminho, para não acontecer que o adversário te entregue ao juiz, e o juiz ao oficial, e te lancem na prisão.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως ἂν ἀποδῷς τὸν ἔσχατον κοδράντην.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
controles.livre: Em verdade te digo que não sairás dali enquanto não pagares a última moeda.

versos.grego: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Οὐ μοιχεύσεις.

controles.web: “You have heard that it was said,  ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
controles.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
controles.livre: Ouvistes o que foi dito: “Não adulterarás”.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ βλέπων γυναῖκα πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι αὐτὴν ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que olhar para uma mulher para a cobiçar, em seu coração já adulterou com ela.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ὁ δεξιὸς σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ· συμφέρει γάρ σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μελῶν σου καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου βληθῇ εἰς γέενναν.

controles.web: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
controles.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
controles.livre: Se o teu olho direito te faz pecar, arranca-o e lança-o de ti; porque é melhor para ti que um dos teus membros se perca do que o teu corpo todo seja lançado no inferno.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ ἡ δεξιά σου χεὶρ σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔκκοψον αὐτὴν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ· συμφέρει γάρ σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μελῶν σου καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου εἰς γέενναν ἀπέλθῃ.

controles.web: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
controles.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
controles.livre: E se a tua mão direita te faz pecar, corta-a e lança-a de ti; porque é melhor para ti que um dos teus membros se perca do que o teu corpo todo vá ao inferno.

versos.grego: Ἐρρέθη δέ Ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, δότω αὐτῇ ἀποστάσιον.

controles.web: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
controles.kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
controles.livre: Também foi dito: “Qualquer um que se divorciar sua mulher, dê a ela carta de separação”.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ἀπολύων τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ παρεκτὸς λόγου πορνείας ποιεῖ αὐτὴν μοιχευθῆναι, καὶ ὃς ἐὰν ἀπολελυμένην γαμήσῃ μοιχᾶται.

controles.web: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que qualquer um que se divorciar de sua mulher, a menos que seja por causa de pecado sexual, faz com que ela adultere; e qualquer um que se casar com a divorciada comete adultério.

versos.grego: Πάλιν ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις Οὐκ ἐπιορκήσεις, ἀποδώσεις δὲ τῷ Κυρίῳ τοὺς ὅρκους σου.

controles.web: “Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
controles.kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
controles.livre: Também ouvistes que foi dito aos antigos: “Não jurarás falsamente”, “mas cumprirás ao Senhor os teus juramentos”.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ὀμόσαι ὅλως· μήτε ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, ὅτι θρόνος ἐστὶν τοῦ Θεοῦ·

controles.web: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo que de maneira nenhuma jureis; nem pelo céu, porque é o trono de Deus;

versos.grego: μήτε ἐν τῇ γῇ, ὅτι ὑποπόδιόν ἐστιν τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ· μήτε εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, ὅτι πόλις ἐστὶν τοῦ μεγάλου Βασιλέως·

controles.web: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
controles.kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
controles.livre: Nem pela terra, porque é o suporte de seus pés; nem por Jerusalém, porque é a cidade do grande Rei.

versos.grego: μήτε ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ σου ὀμόσῃς, ὅτι οὐ δύνασαι μίαν τρίχα λευκὴν ποιῆσαι ἢ μέλαιναν.

controles.web: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
controles.livre: Nem por tua cabeça jurarás, pois nem sequer um cabelo podes tornar branco ou preto.

versos.grego: ἔστω δὲ ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν ναὶ ναί, οὒ οὔ· τὸ δὲ περισσὸν τούτων ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ ἐστιν.

controles.web: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
controles.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
controles.livre: Mas seja vosso falar: “sim”, “sim”, “não”, “não”; porque o que disso passa procede do maligno.

versos.grego: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ καὶ ὀδόντα ἀντὶ ὀδόντος.

controles.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
controles.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
controles.livre: Ouvistes o que foi dito: “Olho por olho, e dente por dente”.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ἀντιστῆναι τῷ πονηρῷ· ἀλλ’ ὅστις σε ῥαπίζει εἰς τὴν δεξιὰν σιαγόνα σου, στρέψον αὐτῷ καὶ τὴν ἄλλην·

controles.web: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
controles.livre: Mas eu vos digo que não resistais a quem for mau; em vez disso, a qualquer um que te bater à tua face direita, mostra-lhe também a outra.

versos.grego: καὶ τῷ θέλοντί σοι κριθῆναι καὶ τὸν χιτῶνά σου λαβεῖν, ἄφες αὐτῷ καὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον·

controles.web: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
controles.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
controles.livre: E ao que quiser disputar contigo, e te tomar tua túnica, deixa-lhe também a capa.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅστις σε ἀγγαρεύσει μίλιον ἕν, ὕπαγε μετ’ αὐτοῦ δύο.

controles.web: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
controles.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
controles.livre: E se qualquer um te obrigar a caminhar uma milha, vai com ele duas.

versos.grego: τῷ αἰτοῦντί σε δός, καὶ τὸν θέλοντα ἀπὸ σοῦ δανίσασθαι μὴ ἀποστραφῇς.

controles.web: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
controles.kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
controles.livre: Dá a quem te pedir; e não te desvies de quem quiser de ti tomar emprestado.

versos.grego: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου καὶ μισήσεις τὸν ἐχθρόν σου.

controles.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor,  and hate your enemy.’
controles.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
controles.livre: Ouvistes o que foi dito: “Amarás teu próximo”, e “odiarás teu inimigo”.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν καὶ προσεύχεσθε ὑπὲρ τῶν διωκόντων ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
controles.livre: Porém eu vos digo: amai vossos inimigos e orai pelos que vos perseguem,

versos.grego: ὅπως γένησθε υἱοὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς, ὅτι τὸν ἥλιον αὐτοῦ ἀνατέλλει ἐπὶ πονηροὺς καὶ ἀγαθοὺς καὶ βρέχει ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ἀδίκους.

controles.web: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
controles.kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
controles.livre: Para que sejais filhos de vosso Pai que está nos céus; porque ele faz seu sol sair sobre maus e bons, e chover sobre justos e injustos.

versos.grego: ἐὰν γὰρ ἀγαπήσητε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς, τίνα μισθὸν ἔχετε; οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ τελῶναι τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν;

controles.web: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
controles.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
controles.livre: Pois se amardes os que vos amam, que recompensa tereis? Não fazem os cobradores de impostos também o mesmo?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν ἀσπάσησθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν μόνον, τί περισσὸν ποιεῖτε; οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ ἐθνικοὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν;

controles.web: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
controles.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
controles.livre: E se saudardes somente os vossos irmãos, o que fazeis de mais? Não fazem os gentios  também assim?

versos.grego: Ἔσεσθε οὖν ὑμεῖς τέλειοι ὡς ὁ Πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος τέλειός ἐστιν.

controles.web: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
controles.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
controles.livre: Portanto, sede vós perfeitos, assim como vosso Pai celestial é perfeito.
